{{Top|leg}}
'''Alasl''' was a type of rock recovered from deposits deep within the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Despite its delicate appearance, alasl was commonly used to create finely crafted bowls and plates.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

Alasl bowls were often noted for their exquisite coloration and thin construction, sometimes translucent enough for light to pass through their bases. These bowls were hand-carved by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and were occasionally sold by offworld [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]].<ref name="TG" />
